name: form-progress
title: Form Progress
description: Watches a form and counts the required fields still empty or invalid, with a Next missing button that moves focus to the next one.

meta.summary: Counts required fields still empty or invalid and jumps to the next one, so people aren't left wondering why a form won't submit.
catches: Fields failing native validation (pattern, minlength and similar)
Fields off-screen, by jumping to them
limits: Relies on native required and constraint validation; custom validation isn't seen
Skips disabled, hidden and inert fields
a11y: Field names come from their <label> (or aria-label/name)
Next missing moves focus to the field
Updates when required, disabled, hidden or inert attributes change
